## Brand

Narrative techniques create engaging, clear, and emotionally resonant digital
experiences. Visuals, copy, and interaction guide users through a cohesive
journey and give functional interfaces a memorable structure.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: playful
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Inter,
  display=Abril Fatface, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500,
  600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Narrative-driven design using visuals, copy, and interaction to guide users
through engaging, emotionally resonant journeys.
